text:
**My pick: XTAR VC4SL**, a 4-bay charger that handles 18650s and most other cylindrical cells.

- It has four independent bays and takes USB-C with QC3.0 input. Charge current is adjustable from 0.25A to 3A, and it fits Li-ion cells from 10440 to 32650, plus NiMH/NiCd ([1lumen](https://1lumen.com/battery-charger-review/xtar-vc4sl/)).
- Its LCD shows voltage, current, capacity and internal resistance for each cell. Best Batteries rated it 4.3/5, with safety at 4.0 ([Best Batteries](https://us.best-batteries.com/reviews/xtar-vc4sl/)).
- VoltRated also recommends it for anyone with 18650/21700 cells ([VoltRated](https://voltrated.com/guides/best-chargers)).
- Downsides: it's a bit bulky, the included cable feels cheap for the price, and no warranty length is stated on the product page. To get full speed you need a QC3.0 power adapter, which may not be included, so check before you buy ([Stephen Knight](https://www.stephenknightphotography.com/post/charger-review-xtar-vc4sl)).

**Other good options**

- **Nitecore UMS4** is the fastest. It delivers up to 3,000 mA in a single slot (QC mode) and has reverse-polarity and short-circuit protection, overtime charging protection, and internal-resistance readout. The USB cable is included, but a QC adapter isn't ([Nitecore](https://www.nitecore.com/mobile-product/ums4)).
- **Keenstone 4-Bay Universal Charger** was the editor's choice at Smashing Robotics. It has selectable 500 mA or 1000 mA charging per bay and UL/CE/FCC certification ([Smashing Robotics](https://www.smashingrobotics.com/best-18650-battery-chargers/)). That review site earns Amazon affiliate commissions, so weigh it accordingly.
- **Tenergy TN270** is the budget choice at $18.99. It's a simple 2-bay charger with reverse-polarity detection that charges at 500 mA per slot, so a 3,000 mAh cell takes about 6–7 hours. It has no USB input, and the listing mentions no safety features beyond reverse-polarity detection and status LEDs. [Buy it here](https://dealectric.com/go/tenergy-tn270-li-ion-18650-charger) ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/answers/best-18650-battery-chargers-2026-xtar-vc4sl-nitecore-ums4-vapcell-s4-plus-review)). That's an affiliate link.

**Buying links:** The search results didn't include direct purchase links for the VC4SL, UMS4 or Keenstone, and I can't browse, so I won't guess at URLs. The reviews linked above point to current prices. Nitecore's page is [here](https://www.nitecore.com/mobile-product/ums4), and the Keenstone is listed on Amazon through the Smashing Robotics page.

**Safety tips:** Pick a charger with independent bays, since paired-slot designs can overcharge one cell. Never put lithium cells in a NiMH-only charger. Slower charging is gentler on cell life if you aren't in a hurry ([VoltRated](https://voltrated.com/guides/best-chargers)).
